Arjun: FYI - BigRetail asked to delay a full catalog deprecation while they finish model rework. They want a reusable "staged-deprec" safety net (TTL + bench gates + temporary pin). Can we spec a pattern? cc @Maya @Felix
Maya: Need exact variant + impact. Which model and what's the observed regression?
Felix: They're pinned to rwd-13b-v1 for now. Canary vs new model: semantic delta ~4.1% on their seed set, embedding recall@10 -2.4pp, p95 +9ms in na-east. Traffic ~90 QPS.
Maya: 4.1% > our 3% enterprise threshold. Proposal: define a "staged-deprecation" lane: short-hold (14d), runway-30, runway-60. Each tier has bench exit gates + optional credits. Use cohort canaries + shadow-serve.
Arjun: Can we reuse an existing checklist and just parameterize thresholds? We want low overhead so PM/CS can propose quickly.
Maya: Draft preflight checklist:
```
- seed-set semantic eval (customer-specific)
- embedding similarity: median cosine delta + recall@k
- perf smoke: p50/p95 regional
- shadow-serve 48h telemetry OK
- cohort opt-in template (per-user rollback)
- structured-output invariants (field presence/order)
- KV-cache warm/cold smoke
- fallback variant exercised
```
Felix: Bench exit gates suggestion: 14d -> delta <=2.5% or targeted mitigation in place; 30d -> delta <=2% & p95 <= baseline+6ms; 60d -> delta <=3% with sustained weekly improvement and mitigation plan.
Renee: Finance/legal: discounts >15% require sign-off. Recommend staged escrow (front-loaded credits released weekly on improvement). Add contract snippet for rollback SLA.
Arjun: Ops: can we automate weekly evals and a canary sequencer that refuses bump if checks fail?
ops-bot: Note: canary traffic <5% of a dedicated pool has no on-call impact per recent policy.
Maya: Action items: (1) Felix to draft the staged-deprec lane doc + comms template, (2) Arjun to prototype CI gating job + webhook, (3) Renee to draft escrow/contract snippet and flag finance if credits>15%. Target internal draft in 5 business days. BrightRetail expects a response in 7. :hourglass:
